reviewer: postgresql subagent (independent of all reviewed product-file owners)

findings.initial: Serialized Promise chain retained pending raw frames behind blocked async consumers.
findings.resolution: Final sink calls each onData immediately, attaches rejection handler immediately and keeps only pending-completion count plus one drain Promise; no newly retained frame queue. Existing adapter transport behavior preserved. Generalized CLI stdout backpressure is not claimed by this fix.

findings.initial: Child exit may precede stderr drainage, losing final typed startup failure.
findings.resolution: Final LayerfsHost close listener derives static CliUnavailable/CliIncompatible guidance only after child stdio closes.

checks: Cancellation output rejection is synchronously observed by installed promise handler and cannot escape as unhandled rejection.
Output delivery drains before execution completion is recorded; command result and Save attempt remain retained.
Partial Save errors stay independent from command/cancellation outcome.
Cancelled consumer rejection cannot terminate host; noncancelled consumer failure is rethrown only after completed command and Save facts are preserved.
Synchronous onData throw and asynchronous rejection both decrement pending count and settle current drain Promise.
Sidebar mode derives from existing preload identity; preview remains simulated; fabricated version removed.
New startup UI error strings contain configuration instructions and fixed identifiers, never raw stderr or credentials.
testsReviewed: Two focused regression cases in exec-cancel.test.js cover cancellation+partial Save and unrelated async consumer rejection after Save. Lead reports final focused 28 PASS.
Native owner reports actual-child startup regression 3 PASS after close-event correction.
evidenceReview: Actual PostgreSQL DoctorPanel complete/incomplete native evidence independently reviewed against retained real reports, including screenshot and exact counts.
Backup live receipts independently peer-reviewed by live_recovery agent, with installed-unrecorded file finding resolved by fresh hash/custody receipt.
limitations: This source review does not substitute for final rebuilt native/package execution. Lead and native owner own final binary checks and restart acceptance.
